$comment: The one Headmaster theme. Edit here, then run `node brand/headmaster/theme/generate.mjs --write` and, for the other repos, add `--repos <folder holding the checkouts>`. Studio (full redesign, owner picks 4 Nov 2026): white and lavender in light, the accent #4b4bc6 (royal blue #0000da is retired); dark is black and grey, never blueish: the accent there is a light grey and lavender stays on small accents such as focus rings. Logo ink on a lime tile in light, lime alone in dark.

desktop.$comment: Desktop dark keeps its fills grey and puts the lavender on small accents only: focus rings, the streaming cursor, active pills and text selection (owner, 4 Nov 2026). Only these fields differ from the shared dark palette.
